entries.083b7605450f1727: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥30,404 million, up 7.1% year on year. By segment, the hotel operation business accounted for ¥16,433 million, the golf operation business ¥8,551 million, the Resol no Mori business ¥4,235 million, the Wellbeing business ¥1,055 million, the renewable energy business ¥102 million, and the investment regeneration business ¥25 million.
entries.0e46c78d838124f8: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, against the backdrop of an increase in inbound visitors to Japan and a shift toward experience-based consumption, the company strengthened its capture of inbound demand, and the hotel operation business led revenue growth. In the golf operation business, the introduction of air-conditioned carts and membership sales contributed, and in the Resol no Mori business, improvements in occupancy rate and average spend per customer and a recovery in corporate training demand contributed. The company is also expanding its lineup of facilities and products, including preparations for opening newly operated hotels and expansion of the vacation home sharing business 'Resol Stay.'
